payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information on how text segmentation is performed, specifically in the context of document classification, and the benefits of this approach.

claims.text: Text segmentation involves dividing lengthy documents into smaller chunks to improve processing and classification results.
The segmented chunks are processed using a BiLSTM architecture to create a single document embedding, enhancing model performance.
Models trained on segmented text chunks yield higher accuracy compared to those using the entire document as input.
